name: Pork, Broccoli & Honey Stir-Fry
method: Slice the pork into 1cm strips. Mix the cornflour with a tablespoon of water and set aside.
Cook the noodles to the packet instructions and drain.
Stir-fry the pork in the oil over a high heat for 3 to 4 minutes, then add the broccoli, sliced pepper, garlic and chilli and cook for 4 minutes.
Add the soy sauce, honey and cornflour mixture and bubble for a minute until glossy, then toss through the noodles.
